whyItMatters: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a resolved pin that records only a revision.
actions: Regenerate the artifact with integrity data enabled and commit the recorded digest or checksum. Specifically: fix a resolved pin that records only a revision.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm Package.resolved no longer carries a resolved pin that records only a revision.
